## Data Encryption  
### In Transit  
**TLS 1.3 (Transport Layer Security):**
- All internet-facing connections encrypted
- HTTPS enforced (HTTP redirects to HTTPS)
- mTLS for internal service-to-service communication
- Certificate management (auto-renewal, monitoring)  
**VPN for Remote Access:**
- Staff working remotely use VPN
- All traffic encrypted through secure tunnel
- Multi-factor authentication required
name: Chunk 10/32

raw_entities.name: Data Encryption Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing encryption of data in transit across internet-facing connections and remote access channels. Establishes mandatory use of TLS 1.3 for all internet connections, HTTPS enforcement, mTLS for internal service communication, and VPN requirements for remote staff access with multi-factor authentication.

raw_entities.name: TLS 1.3 Encryption for Internet-Facing Connections
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all internet-facing connections must be encrypted using TLS 1.3 (Transport Layer Security). Includes certificate management with auto-renewal and monitoring capabilities.
context: TLS 1.3 (Transport Layer Security): All internet-facing connections encrypted

raw_entities.name: HTTPS Enforcement with HTTP Redirect
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to enforce HTTPS protocol for all web connections, with automatic redirection of HTTP traffic to HTTPS to prevent unencrypted data transmission.

raw_entities.name: Mutual TLS for Internal Service Communication
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement for mutual TLS (mTLS) encryption on all internal service-to-service communication to ensure bidirectional authentication and encryption of internal traffic.

raw_entities.name: VPN Requirement for Remote Staff Access
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all staff working remotely must use VPN to encrypt all traffic through a secure tunnel, protecting data in transit from remote locations.
context: All traffic encrypted through secure tunnel

raw_entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication for Remote Access
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that multi-factor authentication must be required for all remote staff accessing the bank's systems via VPN.

raw_entities.name: TLS 1.3 Encryption Implementation
raw_entities.description: Technical control implementing TLS 1.3 encryption for all internet-facing connections with automated certificate management including renewal and monitoring.
context: TLS 1.3 (Transport Layer Security): All internet-facing connections encrypted

raw_entities.name: HTTPS Enforcement Control
raw_entities.description: Technical control that enforces HTTPS protocol and automatically redirects unencrypted HTTP traffic to HTTPS endpoints.

raw_entities.name: Mutual TLS Authentication Control
raw_entities.description: Technical control implementing mutual TLS for internal service-to-service communication, ensuring bidirectional certificate-based authentication and encryption.

raw_entities.name: VPN Encryption Tunnel
raw_entities.description: Technical control providing encrypted VPN tunnel for remote staff to securely transmit all traffic to the bank's network.
context: All traffic encrypted through secure tunnel

raw_entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication for Remote Access
raw_entities.description: Access control requiring multi-factor authentication as a prerequisite for remote staff to establish VPN connections.

raw_entities.name: Remote Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members working remotely who are required to use VPN with multi-factor authentication to encrypt all traffic and maintain secure access to bank systems.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach in Transit
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized interception or exposure of sensitive data transmitted over internet-facing connections or remote access channels due to lack of encryption.
context: All traffic encrypted through secure tunnel

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Internal Service Access
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized access to internal service-to-service communications due to lack of mutual authentication and encryption.

raw_entities.name: Remote Access Compromise
raw_entities.description: Risk of unauthorized access to bank systems by remote staff or interception of remote traffic due to lack of encryption or weak authentication.
